title: Read the Firm Quote Clock
description: The anchor returns a firm SEP-38 quote. Unlike an indicative quote, a firm quote is a commitment the anchor will honor, but only until a stated moment. The wallet must read that field before presenting the price to the player.

content.prompt: Which field in a SEP-38 quote response tells the client when the quoted price stops being valid?

hint: Firm quotes carry an `expires_at` timestamp; after it passes the anchor no longer has to honor the price. `price` and the amount fields describe the exchange, not its lifetime. Documentation: https://developers.stellar.org/docs/build/apps/wallet/sep38
author: StellarHunts Core
